name: General-government gross debt / GDP
mechanism: Interest income to creditors versus debt-service, fiscal adjustment and risk-premium channels
direction: ambiguous; gamma>0 would mean less contraction / more price-level response as debt rises
literature: BIS WP 1365 (2026); existing repository creditor-residence research
concern: historical WEO estimates/revisions; debt is endogenous; one lag does not make Z exogenous

name: Central-government debt / GDP
concern: central versus general government are distinct sectors

name: Debt held by domestic residents / GDP
mechanism: Domestic receipt of sovereign interest income
concern: includes central bank; portfolio and valuation differences

name: Domestic private sovereign holdings excluding central bank / GDP
mechanism: Resident creditor interest income versus bank-sovereign exposure and fiscal adjustment
source: Fang-Hardy-Lewis full 101-country file; official IMF/Eurostat extension
literature: Fang, Hardy and Lewis (2025); Arslanalp and Tsuda; existing repository
concern: domestic outside-central-bank is a provider sector definition; nonbank public entities may be included

name: Foreign-held sovereign debt / GDP
mechanism: Foreign leakage of interest income and external financing
concern: residence differs from nationality and currency

name: Central-bank-held government debt / GDP
mechanism: Remittances and consolidated public-sector interest flows

name: Domestic banks sovereign holdings / GDP
mechanism: Sovereign-bank nexus and bank interest receipts
concern: loans versus securities; bank balance sheets

name: Domestic nonbank sovereign holdings / GDP
concern: pension funds and households have different MPCs

name: Foreign official sovereign holdings / GDP (inferred completion of truncated item)
mechanism: Official external financing and interest-income leakage
concern: the user catalogue ended mid-F10; this measure is an explicitly inferred completion

name: Sovereign principal refinancing within one year
mechanism: Faster repricing of sovereign interest payments and creditor income
source: Observed debt schedules in existing official-expansion inventory
literature: De Graeve and Mazzolini / BIS WP 1365 (2026); existing repository
concern: remaining maturity, not original maturity; government portfolios and valuations differ by source

name: Net energy imports / energy use
mechanism: Energy import costs, currency adjustment and supply sensitivity
literature: CWY cost/exchange-rate channels; no priority/novelty claim
concern: not a monetary-policy-specific exposure; net exporters have negative values; global energy shocks

name: Private nonfinancial debt service ratio
direction: usually more contraction at higher DSR, conditional on identification
indicator: WS_DSR; precise sector key pending download audit
concern: BIS DSR is a constructed aggregate with maturity assumptions

name: Remunerated central-bank reserves
mechanism: Policy-rate-sensitive payments to banks and depositors
source: Central-bank balance sheets and remuneration rules
concern: reserve volumes alone do not identify remuneration; regime dates must be verified
